issues.detail: The Greek 'τι εστιν' (what it is) is rendered as 'điều này có nghĩa là' (this means that), which changes the structure from a question/definition to an explanatory statement.
The Greek 'ει δε εγνωκειτε' (if you do not know) is translated as 'Nếu các ngươi biết' (If you know), reversing the negation.
